comment: With floating inventory letters (!fixinv), #adjust offers only the letters up to the first open slot while fewer than 52 stacks are carried (invent.c doorganize_core() 5109-5110): at 50 stacks moving an item offers its own letter and 'Y' but not 'Z', and at 51 stacks splitting offers no new letter. A Valkyrie builds the stacks by splitting wished darts.
